title: Hoshino Ichika — Star Piece Connection〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This early, no one else should be here, which means I can focus on writing lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“How lost I may be doesn't matter,
I know everything will be all right
as long as we're together”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, we can't use that...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because it's so obvious...
It also makes it seem like I put far too much of my own feelings into these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...?
What's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're the one writing these, so I don't see any problems with you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I like these lyrics more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They really seemed to like it more when I didn't do anything fancy...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is that how I should be thinking about this? Being more open and direct.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I don't have time to worry right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki and the others are waiting on me.
I have to keep doing everything I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (For now, I'll go with this. Still, it doesn't really leave anything to the imagination.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is this really the best way to express what Saki's trying to convey through her song?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Kiritani, good morning.
Are you coming back from your morning practice?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You're here quite early too, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was, well... Working on my lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you mean for the song Tenma wrote?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you having some trouble with them...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was so sure that I'd be able to write something good at first, but now I feel completely stuck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, what kind of lyrics are you going for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's song is about how things will get better even if they're not so great right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm trying to find the right words so that her message can be heard as clearly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I keep second-guessing myself and wondering if what I have is really the right way to go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On a scale of 1 to 100, Hoshino, where do you want your lyrics to be given that you finished writing them as they are right now...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hmm...
80, maybe? 70 at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's very high for a first draft, no...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A 70's high?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For reference, whenever I start learning a new song, I'd aim for around 30 first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A 30?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I try to go one step at a time.
First a 30, then a 50 and so on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More specifically, that 30 from my first time around would also take into account how I interpret a song's themes, motifs or story...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So if 100 is perfection, I'd like to start somewhere much lower, like a 30.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand... Whenever we start learning a new song, we begin by going over its theme or lyrics first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means you should try writing your lyrics in sort of the same manner, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The same manner...
By taking it one step at a time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Would it be much easier to see where you are or how far you've progressed that way? Not to mention that it'd be significantly less stressful.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if I were to aim for a 30...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I should work on creating a rough outline of the song's story first!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've never written my own lyrics before and I'm sort of just parroting what I learned from working as an idol, but I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, thank you! You've been such a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (For working as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I almost forgot that she used to be one of the most famous idols in the country. Her professionalism is just so incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And she was kind enough to give me some useful advice. I can't let it go to waste.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani, would it be okay if I jotted this down somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay... Take it one step at a time...
Start by aiming for a 30...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But songs are about conveying how you feel to someone, Hoshino, so you may want to think about how you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Interpreting a song's themes, motifs and story...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm sure she'll be just fine.
